levels.title: One last fold
levels.objective: Expose the hinge bore and withdraw the brass-collared retaining pin.

levels.title: Along the frog
levels.objective: Release the clamping hardware and extract the iron along its inclined frog.

levels.title: The open cam
levels.objective: Retract both opposed bolts and lift the hardened shackle.

levels.title: Through the mill
levels.objective: Lift the coupled burr and release the grounds drawer.

levels.title: Behind the film frame
levels.objective: Extract the film holder from the open rear guide.

levels.title: Nested service window
levels.objective: Align the nested tubes and release the reticle cell through the right side.

levels.title: The crank’s clearance
levels.objective: Free the piston from the cylinder.

levels.title: The suspended movement
levels.objective: Align the service cam, arrest the train, release its bridge, and extract the intermediate wheel.
